ann.t: General Updates — Bajaj Finserv Limited has informed the Exchange about the Subscription to the Warrants issued by Bajaj Finance Limited, a listed subsidiary of the Company
Outcome of Board Meeting — Bajaj Finserv Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
Acquisition — Bajaj Finserv Limited has informed the Exchange about the incorporation of a wholly owned subsidiary company i.e. Bajaj Reinsurance Limited

Acquisition — Bajaj Finserv Limited has informed the Exchange about subscription of warrants convertible into equivalent number of Equity Shares for an aggregate consideration not exceeding Rs. 5,800 Crore by way of preferential issue by Bajaj Finance Limited.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Bajaj Finserv Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the unaudited financial results for the period ended 30 June 2026.
Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet/Con. Call Updates — Bajaj Finserv Limited has informed the Exchange about the Conference call for financial results for the quarter ended 30 June 2026.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Bajaj Finserv Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended March 31, 2026.
Change in Auditors — Bajaj Finserv Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Change in Auditors of the company.

Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations — Niraj Bajaj has Submitted to the Exchange a copy of Disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
General Updates — Bajaj Finserv Limited has informed the Exchange about completion of acquisition of entire 26% equity stake held by Allianz SE in Insurance subsidiaries.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Bajaj Finserv Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended December 31, 2025.
Resignation — Bajaj Finserv Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of Shri Purav Jhaveri as President - Investments of the company w.e.f. January 31, 2026 (close of business hours).
General Updates — Bajaj Finserv Limited has informed the Exchange about the update on the acquisition of 50% equity stake in Bajaj Financial Distributors Limited from Allianz SE.
General Updates — Bajaj Finserv Limited has informed the Exchange about the update on acquisition of 23% stake held by Allianz SE in insurance subsidiaries

aud.t: Change in Auditors — Bajaj Finserv Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Change in Auditors of the company.
